taxonomy: The threat taxonomy the suite is built from — adversarial tactics and techniques for AI systems and the agentic attack classes — so each test traces to a named technique rather than to intuition.
suite: The versioned adversarial suite, kept alongside the model and run against the registered version, so coverage grows over time instead of resetting at each launch.
run: The suite runs in CI or on a schedule against the registered version, and each finding names the technique that produced it, so the same attack is not rediscovered every quarter.
triage: Every finding is routed through triage: fixed, or accepted with a recorded rationale and an owner; nothing is left as a slide of jailbreaks.
fixed: A fix ships and the confirmed finding is fed back into the suite as a regression test, so a closed attack stays closed.
accepted: A risk accepted on the record, with the owner and rationale that make the acceptance itself auditable.
record: The structured evidence record filed against the registry entry, showing what was found, fixed or accepted.
